title: The Oil-Chip Parallel
subtitle: Two resource denials, eight decades apart

eraA.title: Growing dependence
eraA.description: Japan imports 80% of oil from U.S. — critical vulnerability.

eraB.title: Growing dependence
eraB.description: China imports 90% of advanced chips. TSMC concentration risk.

eraA.title: Asset freeze & oil embargo
eraA.description: U.S. freezes Japanese assets, cuts oil supply entirely. 18-month reserves begin counting down.

eraB.title: Export controls
eraB.description: Biden chip controls cut China off from advanced semiconductors. Existing inventory begins depleting.

eraA.title: Diplomatic failure
eraA.description: Hull Note demands full withdrawal. Japan sees no path to negotiated access.

eraB.title: Escalation spiral
eraB.description: Netherlands & Japan join restrictions. China sees coordinated containment.

eraA.title: Pearl Harbor
eraA.description: Calculated gamble: seize resources by force before reserves run out.

eraB.description: The structural pressure remains. The parallel asks: what is China's Pearl Harbor?
